cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.

mechanism: A interprets the rota and limited swap agreement as the expert scheduler to make B take the unwanted current bin duty.
confusable: D169 recruits a new official duty; D173 proves an existing rule already assigns the task to B.
comparison: Household reciprocal swapping differs from a club office inheriting a cost-saving rule.
seedUse: Keep B-requested one-week box, clarifying the exact days so the obligation is legible.
